text:
maria: Quick poll — lunch today: sushi 🍣 / tacos 🌮 / salad 🥗. React with :one: sushi, :two: tacos, :three: salad or drop a reply. Need to order for the team in 20m :grin:
lunchbot: Reminder: team lunch budget $12/person. Order cutoff 11:35am.
sam: :two: tacos all the way 🌮
kevin: :one: sushi please. Also anyone allergic to shellfish? @maria
olivia: :two: tacos for me too. can we get extra salsa?
jade: :three: salad — trying to be good today :sweat_smile:
henry: :one: sushi, but no wasabi pls
kevin: Also pro tip: order from Sakana downtown for faster pickup (they're quick)
sam: If tacos win, can we add guac? essential. :eyes:
olivia: yes guac :+1:
maria: Quick tally so far — sushi: kevin, henry; tacos: sam, olivia; salad: jade. Closing in 3 mins.
henry: actually, tacos sound better today. switching to :two: 
maria: Awesome — ordering from La Taqueria then. Adding guac + extra salsa. Charging to team card, please DM me any dietary notes.
lunchbot: Order placed. ETA ~12:10. Enjoy! :tada:
